item.title: Ather Energy among 15 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 30% in a month
item.description: The Sensex gained 384 points to close at 77,301, while 15 BSE 500 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs. Ather Energy, PVR Inox, Marico and Indian Hotels featured among notable gainers, reflecting broad market momentum.

item.title: Sebi cancels registrations of 8 investment advisers for non-payment of renewal fees
item.description: Sebi has announced relaxed KYC requirements for Non-Resident Indians, Overseas Citizens of India, and foreign nationals. These changes will allow them to complete digital onboarding from FATF-compliant countries effectively. Intermediaries can accept KYC submissions without requiring physical presence in India. Video In-Person Verification is now permitted where in-person verification isn't feasible, enhancing compliance capabilities. The revised framework, effective from December 3, is aimed at simplifying the entire onboarding process.

item.title: Nykaa Q2 Results: PAT soars 207% YoY to Rs 101 crore, revenue up 28%; co to acquire 82% stake in Simply Nam
item.description: Nykaa reported a 207% year-on-year profit surge to Rs 101 crore in Q2FY27, with revenue rising 28% to Rs 3,006 crore. Beauty and fashion businesses accelerated growth, while quick commerce, owned brands and strategic acquisitions strengthened expansion.

item.title: Auto sales growth to cool post-festive season, says Monarch; bets on Minda Corp, RK Forgings and Sundram Fasteners
item.description: Auto sales growth is expected to moderate in the second half of FY27 after strong festive demand, while tractor sales may remain weak. Monarch Networth Capital prefers diversified ancillary players Minda Corporation, RK Forgings and Sundram Fasteners, with potential upside of up to 44%.

item.title: Lenskart Q2 Results: Profit zooms 122% YoY to Rs 227 crore; revenue grows 36%
item.description: Lenskart Solutions achieved a net profit of Rs 227.08 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting a 122.1% YoY increase. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 2,845.03 crore, marking a 35.7% YoY growth. Product margin improved to 64% compared to 63.4% in the same quarter last year. The company added 165 new stores in Q2FY27, enhancing its active store count to 3,624.

item.title: Dr Lal PathLabs posts higher quarterly profit on strong diagnostic test demand
item.description: Dr Lal PathLabs announced a 27% increase in its second-quarter profit, with net earnings rising to 1.92 billion rupees. The company experienced a near 20% increase in consolidated revenue from operations during this period. A rise in healthcare awareness has fueled the demand for preventive health check-ups, contributing to these earnings. Dr Lal tested 13.6% more samples this quarter compared to the previous year.

item.title: Allcargo Logistics Q2 Results: Co posts Rs 19 crore profit; revenue rises 3.4%
item.description: Allcargo Logistics Ltd reported a positive shift in financial performance during the September quarter of FY27, achieving a consolidated profit after tax of Rs 19 crore. This demonstrates a year-on-year growth alongside a 3.4 percent increase in operational revenue. With the festive season on the horizon, the company anticipates further demand, focusing on enhancing capacity utilization and reinstating volume growth in the upcoming months.

item.title: Bayer CropScience Q2 profit rises 9% to Rs 166 crore despite 19% decline in revenue
item.description: Bayer CropScience Ltd has announced an impressive 8.84% growth in net profit, totaling Rs 166.2 crore for Q2 FY27. However, total income saw a 19.4% decline year-over-year, attributed to ongoing market challenges. Factors such as unpredictable monsoon patterns have disrupted both sowing and crop protection demand. In response, the company emphasizes efficiency improvements and portfolio enhancements, while the board has declared an interim dividend of Rs 90 per share.

item.title: Saregama India Q2 net profit jumps over 46% to Rs 64.2 cr, revenue grows 36.6%
item.description: Saregama India has reported an impressive 46.4 percent rise in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter. Alongside this, the company’s operational revenue saw a 36.63 percent increase, with the music segment generating Rs 251.3 crore and live events thriving remarkably. The total income for the first half of FY27 reached Rs 587.28 crore, showcasing solid financial results.

item.title: 12 BSE 500 stocks defy market trend, rally up to 65% in 3 months
item.description: While the BSE 500 declined around 5% over the past three months, 12 stocks bucked the broader market trend, delivering gains ranging from 25% to 64%. Welspun Living led the rally, followed by Ather Energy and Welspun Corp.

item.title: Kopsi, Taiwan, other Asian stocks tumble after US midterm elections signal Democratic victory. What’s the connection?
item.description: South Korean and Taiwanese equities tumbled as a potential Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections fuelled concerns over tighter AI regulations and slower data centre investments. Chipmakers led the sell-off, dragging regional markets lower, while Asian currencies strengthened against a weaker dollar.

item.title: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares jump 9% after Balaji Nuthalapadi’s appointment as interim CEO
item.description: The bank further said that appointment of Nuthalapadi as interim CEO, consequent to the resignation of P. N. Vasudevan as the MD & CEO, shall take effect from the date of RBI approval or such other date as may be stipulated by the RBI in this regard.

item.title: Titan Company Q2 results preview: Profit may rise up to 27% YoY; jewellery growth, margins in focus
item.description: Titan Company is set to release its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Brokerage forecasts suggest revenue growth could range from 18.8% to 27% compared to the previous year. Additionally, a substantial year-on-year profit increase of around 27% is anticipated. Key focal points will include jewellery performance, margins, and the growth trajectory of CaratLane, with brokerages recommending a buy on Titan shares due to potential upside.

item.title: Diwali 2026: Will Sensex, Nifty reclaim their peaks or scale new highs? Analysts map the road ahead
item.description: Market analysts are tentatively optimistic about Indian equity markets seeing a resurgence in the next financial year. Expectations suggest that both the Sensex and Nifty may rise to their past peak levels by Diwali 2027, driven by improving corporate profitability. While favorable valuations and steady domestic investments bolster this outlook, global uncertainties like inflation, interest rates, and oil prices could pose challenges.

item.title: BLS Polymers shares rally 6% after strong stock market debut
item.description: BLS Polymers shares extended their strong debut gains, rising nearly 6% on Wednesday after listing at a 65% premium to the IPO price. The issue received 241 times subscription, while the company reported higher income and profit in FY26.

item.title: ITC shares jump 6% in two days after Q2 results. More upside ahead?
item.description: ITC shares rose to Rs 283.5 apiece on NSE on Wednesday morning, the highest level seen by the stock in nearly three months. The stock has now recovered more than 12% in five sessions after hitting a 52-week low of Rs 253 apiece in late October.

item.title: Bharat Electronics shares gain 3% as Motilal raises target price after Q2; Elara Capital upgrades to Buy
item.description: Bharat Electronics shares gained after Motilal Oswal raised its price target and Elara Capital upgraded its rating to Buy. Brokerages cited strong order visibility, healthy revenue growth and margin prospects, while delays in major defence orders remain a key risk.

item.title: Entering the new Samvat: How to position your portfolio for long-term wealth creation
item.description: As investors enter Vikram Samvat 2083 amid market volatility, disciplined portfolio construction matters more than short-term predictions. Sound asset allocation, genuine diversification, regular reviews and continued SIP investing can help investors manage uncertainty and build long-term wealth.

item.title: Awfis Space Solutions shares rally 13% after Q2 profit jumps 94% YoY, revenue rises 20%
item.description: Awfis Space Solutions shares rallied after the company reported 94% year-on-year profit growth and a 20% rise in Q2 FY27 revenue. Strong seat sales, premium workspace expansion and enterprise demand supported its operational performance, even as FIIs and mutual funds trimmed stakes.

item.title: Bajaj Finserv shares rise 2%, extend gains after Q2 results. Why Jefferies reduced target price but still sees 34% upside
item.description: Bajaj Finserv shares had gained around 2% on Tuesday as well after the company announced the earnings, reporting a 17% YoY increase in revenue from operations to Rs 43,416 crore for the second quarter of the ongoing financial year 2027, from Rs 37,215 crore reported in the year-ago period. The shares of the company rose further to Rs 1,749 apiece on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Sensex jumps 383 points, Nifty closes above 23,950 as benchmark indices scale 2-month highs. What lies ahead?
item.description: The Indian stock market has surged, with both Sensex and Nifty climbing to their highest points in two months. As investors keep a keen eye on outcomes from the US midterm elections, which could influence international exchanges, major sectors such as Realty and FMCG have thrived. There's a marked increase in buying from foreign institutional investors, suggesting renewed confidence in large-cap stocks.

item.title: Diwali dhamaka stocks: Eternal, ICICI Bank, among 10 with upside of up to 34%
item.description: As the cautious journey of Samvat 2083 unfolds against a backdrop of external challenges, JM Financial unveils ten promising stocks for Diwali investment. ICICI Bank stands out for anticipated returns and robust loan growth. Bharat Electronics and Eternal are recognized for their strategic sector positions and remarkable growth prospects. In light of a volatile market shaped by global incidents, these selections embody long-term growth potential despite current economic uncertainties.

item.title: Samvat 2083 stock picks! Adani Power, Coal India, 8 others to add in your portfolio this festive season
item.description: ​HDFC Securities unveils a list of ten promising stocks ideal for festive season investments, showcasing growth prospects across multiple sectors. This selection features established giants such as Ambuja Cements and rising stars like Emcure Pharmaceuticals. Each stock comes with a recommended investment range aimed at enticing upside targets. Investors are urged to align their picks with personal sector strategies and market trends, enabling a well-rounded approach to opportunities.

item.title: Arisinfra Solutions reports 110% rise in H1 net profit to Rs 42.9 cr
item.description: Arisinfra Solutions reported a 110% jump in first-half profit as revenue and operating margins improved. Strong growth in contract manufacturing and its Developer as a Service business helped the company post its highest-ever quarterly profit.

item.title: Emcure Pharma shares hit 10% upper circuit after FY27 guidance hike; Jefferies raises target price by 8%
item.description: Emcure Pharma shares hit a 10% upper circuit after strong Q2 FY27 results prompted the company to raise its full-year growth guidance. Brokerages turned more positive, citing robust international business, improving domestic growth and a strong product pipeline.

item.title: Marico among 7 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
item.description: Six Nifty500 stocks gained over 4% on November 3 and featured in StockEdge’s White Marubozu bullish scanner. The candlestick pattern indicates strong buying momentum, with stocks closing near their session highs.

item.title: Diwali 2026: Will banking stocks shine in Samvat 2083? Analysts list top picks
item.description: With Diwali 2026 on the horizon, banking stocks like HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Karur Vysya Bank are drawing attention from analysts as potential winners for Samvat 2083. Following a period of volatility, these stocks are anticipated to regain momentum, driven by consistent loan growth and enhanced management practices. Investors are advised to navigate the changing landscape prudently as opportunities unfold.

item.title: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels shares list at 6% premium over IPO price
item.description: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels made its stock market debut at a 6% premium over its IPO price. The company raised Rs 275.40 crore through its initial public offering, which saw high investor interest. Shares opened at Rs 171 compared to the issue price of Rs 162, indicating strong demand. The company's financial performance showed significant growth, with income rising to Rs 539 crore in FY26.

MCX shares tumble 7% even as Q2 net profit surges 130% YoY, revenue more than doubles
item.description: MCX shares fell nearly 7% despite reporting 130% growth in second-quarter net profit and a 114% rise in revenue. Jefferies said EBITDA was largely in line with estimates, while higher technology costs and taxes affected the results.

item.title: SBI share price target: Jefferies, Motilal, others see up to 34% upside in state lender. Buy, sell or hold?
item.description: State Bank of India has seen a remarkable 15% increase in profits year-on-year, totaling Rs 23,038 crore for the second quarter. With a loan book surpassing Rs 52 lakh crore and a 10% rise in interest income, brokerages have set optimistic Buy ratings on SBI shares, suggesting target prices between Rs 1,225 and Rs 1,350. Despite this positive outlook, management highlighted possible obstacles from macroeconomic shifts and potential treasury losses.

item.title: Angel One among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
item.description: Four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5% on November 3 featured in StockEdge’s RSI Trending Up scan, with their Relative Strength Index (RSI) crossing above 50 from below, signalling strengthening price momentum.

item.description: Four Nifty500 stocks closed more than 1.4% above their respective volume-weighted average prices on November 3, according to StockEdge’s technical scan.

item.title: NSE shares gain as Jefferies, other brokerages remain bullish after Q2 results. What lies ahead?
item.description: NSE reported a 23% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 2,578 crore, driven by higher trading volumes and transaction revenue. The exchange also approved divesting up to 40% stake in its coal exchange subsidiary. Jefferies and Emkay maintained Buy ratings, projecting further upside in NSE shares.

Two SME IPOs list today: Carver Roboweld, Ajwa Projects shares make BSE SME debut
item.description: Ajwa Projects and Carver Roboweld are set to list on the BSE SME platform on November 4, 2026, after collectively raising Rs 66.34 crore. While Ajwa Projects’ IPO received modest subscription of 1.12 times, Carver Roboweld attracted strong investor demand, achieving an overall subscription of 25.80 times.

India's stock market volatility since last Diwali saw 60 stocks lose up to 96%
item.description: At least 63 stocks with a market capitalisation of over Rs 1,000 crore have lost more than half their value since last Diwali, with some plunging 60-95% amid a broad-based selloff across sectors. Elitecon International was the worst performer, tumbling 96%, followed by Reliance Infrastructure, Kothari Industrial Corporation and Fischer Medical Ventures.
